title: Simulador Oficial Completo TOEIC® - Versión 3
description: Simulador completo real de Listening & Reading enfocado en Nexus Industries y el líder the HR Director.

parts.visual:
## 📝 Simulador Oficial TOEIC® (Versión 3)

Evaluación de **Listening & Reading** en tiempo real:

1. **Listening Section**: Evalúa tu comprensión en Nexus Industries usando NovaCRM.
2. **Reading Section**: Mide tu análisis gramatical de memorandos emitidos por the HR Director.

*Inicia tu prueba simulada oficial.*
parts.audio: Welcome to the Full TOEIC Simulation. Manage your time efficiently across both listening and reading stages. Let's begin.

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTO]: Select the best description of Nexus Industries's office photo.
questions.audio_script: A) They are interviewing a job applicant. B) The HR offices are being painted. C) They are printing employee contracts. D) They are leaving the training hall.
questions.explanation: La descripción B es errónea; la A es correcta porque representa una entrevista formal de selección.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the dialogue and answer: What does the man agree to do next?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi Jessica, did you see the new HR guidelines from Nexus Industries?
W: Yes, they focus on payroll integration and onboarding. The HR Director sent the draft.
M: I will email the HR team to schedule our onboarding walkthrough.
options: Sign the contract as currently written.
Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
Write a new memorandum to sales staff.
questions.correct_answer: Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
questions.explanation: El hombre dice: 'I will call their manager to negotiate an extension'.

questions.question:
[PART 5]: Complete the business sentence correctly:

"All employees are strictly required to comply ___ the updated security rules in NovaCRM."
questions.explanation: El verbo 'comply' rige gramaticalmente la preposición 'with' (comply with / cumplir con).

questions.question:
[PART 7]: Read the memorandum and answer: **When will the migration to NovaCRM officially occur?**

**MEMORANDUM**

*To:* Hiring Managers
*From:* HR Department
*Subject: Onboarding and NovaCRM Setup*

Please note that starting next Thursday, all candidate evaluation files must be uploaded to NovaCRM. A workshop will be held this Wednesday at 11:30 AM in Conference Room C.
questions.explanation: El memorando dice: 'starting next Wednesday, we are officially retiring our legacy sales tool and migrating to NovaCRM'.
